title: Completed library filter media-kind fallback
summary: Update the Completed Current Output Status library filter to fall back to media kind/type when completed rows do not include library profile metadata.
reason: Operators can have current Movie or TV outputs whose completed rows lack library_id/library_name/library_designation, causing the filter to show only All libraries and Unknown library.
behavior_before: Completed rows without library profile metadata appeared under Unknown library even when they carried Movie or TV media kind/type evidence.
behavior_after: Completed rows still prefer explicit library profile identity, but fall back to normalized Movie or TV labels before using Unknown library.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_row_detail_smoke.WebViewRowDetailSmoke - blocked by unrelated queueView fake-DOM insertAdjacentElement gap before Completed assertions
rollback_plan: Revert the Completed filter helper and focused Completed library-filter smoke test to restore the previous Unknown library fallback behavior.
notes:
WebView display/filtering-only change. No backend route, filesystem mutation, media policy, queue, publish/drain, rename, or settings behavior changes.
Strict change-control coverage passed for the dirty worktree.
